tei:div.tei:p: da) pa la/ bka' babs bzhi pa dgongs gter gyi skor la/ 'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sgyu 'phrul rol mo/ 'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig las/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ 'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig gi mchod phreng lhan thabs su sbyar ba sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyan/ 'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa'i skong ba sgyu 'phrul rnam par bkod pa'i sprin phung*/ rtsa gsum skong bshags nyer bsdus kun bzang mchod sprin/ 'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig las/ smin byed rtsa ba'i dbang bzhi bklag chog tu bkod pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i char rgyun/ 'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig las/ smin byed rtsa ba'i dbang bzhi/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tshe dbang bcud 'dzin/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ phrin las ye shes snang ba/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa/ 'phags ma'i snying thig gi sman mchod/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi tshogs grangs bsogs/ sgrol dkar mchod phreng cung zad rgyas pa/ 'chi med 'phags ma snying tig gi skong ba rin chen phreng mdzes/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las/ smin byed rtsa ba'i dbang chog ye shes thig le/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las/ thun mong tshe yi rjes gnang*/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las/ yang zab tshe yi byin rlabs/ tshe 'gugs/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bdag 'jug ngag 'don ye shes dwangs bcud/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ rtsa ba'i smin byed bklag chog tu bkod pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las/ thun mong tshe'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las/ yang zab tshe'-i byin rlabs kyi phyag len gsal bar bkod pa ye shes thig le/

'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi sbyin sreg cho ga ye shes rab tu rgyas pa/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi dngos grub len pa'i bzlas dmigs/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa dang 'brel ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid mdor bsdus 'chi med grub pa'i zil dngar/ dgongs gter 'phags ma'i snying thig gi bsnyen sgrub ji ltar bya ba'i zin bris zla zer bdud rtsi'i thig le/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bsnyen sgrub las brtsams pa'i dris lan cung zad/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bzlas dmigs/ yongs rdzogs 'chi med snying thig dang*/ 'phags ma'i snying tig gi gtor ma'i pra khrid 'chi med 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dga' ston/ dgongs gter 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi sgrub khog ye shes gter mdzod/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi cha lag rnam rgyal ma rig lnga'i stong mchod kyi brgyud 'debs 'chi med rtag pa'i dbyangs snyan/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi cha lag gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs sgrub dang mchod pa'i cho ga bltas gsal du bkod pa dri med nor bu/ tshe lha rnam gsum la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'chi med grub pa'i gseng lam/ bla ma tshe lha rnam gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel bar tshogs gnyis spel ba'i cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston/ maṇḍal rgyas pa tshom bu so bdun ma/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la rtsa sngags dang sbyar ba'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa don kun grub pa'i dbyangs snyan/ 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum gyi bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la bstod pa 'chi med zla gzhon gsar pa'i rol mo/ 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal la bstod pa 'chi med grub pa sprin gyi rol mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo la bstod pa 'chi med sprin dkar 'dzum pa'i rol mo/

'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las/ bla sgrub byin rlabs snying po/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi bla sgrub byin rlabs snying po'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs snang ba/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ bla sgrub byin rlabs snying po'i las byang bklag chog tu bsdebs pa byin rlabs bcud 'dren/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ bla sgrub byin rlabs snying po'i bshags skong gi lag len dang 'don 'grigs khrigs su bkod pa/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ bla sgrub byin rlabs snying po'i dbang bskur bltas chog tu bkod pa byin rlabs bcud 'bebs/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ bla sgrub byin rlabs snying po'i rdo rje tshe'i dbang zab mo khol du phyung ba byin rlabs srog 'tsho/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ bla sgrub byin rlab snying po'i sgrub chen gyi lag len 'dus gsal du bkod pa bde chen nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ bla sgrub byin rlabs snying po'i sman sgrub kyi ngag 'don gsal bar bkod pa 'pho med bdud rtsi'i bcud len/
